In an indoor martial arts studio, the bearded Black man in a white gi (R1) on the left and the Asian man with braided hair in a gray gi (R2) on the right grapple closely on a dark mat. R1 leans forward with his head tucked low under R2's chest, while R2 grips R1's upper body. Warm indoor lighting casts soft shadows.
